# Kubernetes Multi-Environment Deployment Pipeline

## Overview
This dataset describes a Kubernetes deployment pipeline spanning four environments (dev, staging, canary, production) with automated rollback mechanisms, blue-green traffic switching at the production stage, and HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) scaling decision points at every environment.

## Data Source

### pipeline_nodes
34 nodes representing pipeline steps. Fields: `id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (string, human-readable name), `lane` (string: dev | staging | canary | production | global), `type` (string: action | check | decision | hpa_decision | hpa_action | rollback | terminal), `order` (integer, sequencing hint). Some nodes carry additional threshold fields such as `cpu_threshold_pct`, `mem_threshold_pct`, `error_rate_threshold_pct`, `p99_latency_ms_threshold`, `traffic_pct`, and `duration_min`.

### pipeline_edges
48 directed edges. Fields: `from` and `to` (node id references), `type` (string: forward | rollback | hpa_branch | blue_green), `label` (string, condition or annotation on the edge).

### hpa_policies
4 rows, one per environment. Fields: `environment`, `min_replicas`, `max_replicas`, `cpu_target_pct`, `mem_target_pct`, `scale_up_cooldown_sec`, `scale_down_cooldown_sec`. Replica counts are integers; thresholds are percentages.

### environment_config
4 rows. Fields: `environment`, `namespace`, `gate_error_rate_pct` (float), `gate_p99_latency_ms` (integer or null), `traffic_strategy` (string: direct | weighted_canary | blue_green), `rollback_auto` (boolean), `approval_required` (boolean).

## Data Notes
- Threshold values tighten progressively from dev to production (e.g., error-rate gate: 5% → 2% → 1% → 0.5%).
- The canary stage uses three progressive traffic ramp steps (10% → 25% → 50%) before the production gate.
- Blue-green switching applies only to the production environment; other environments use direct or weighted-canary strategies.
- HPA scale-up and scale-down nodes are shared (global lane) and referenced from each environment's HPA check.

---
config:
  theme: base
  themeVariables:
    primaryColor: '#1e3a5f'
    primaryTextColor: '#ffffff'
    primaryBorderColor: '#2d5986'
    lineColor: '#4a90d9'
    secondaryColor: '#0d2137'
    tertiaryColor: '#162d4a'
    background: '#0a1628'
    mainBkg: '#1e3a5f'
    nodeBorder: '#2d5986'
    clusterBkg: '#0d2137'
    titleColor: '#e8f4ff'
    edgeLabelBackground: '#0d2137'
    fontFamily: 'JetBrains Mono, Courier New, monospace'
  flowchart:
    htmlLabels: true
    curve: basis
    nodeSpacing: 50
    rankSpacing: 60
    padding: 20
---
flowchart TD
    %% ============================================================
    %% LEGEND
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph LEGEND["  LEGEND"]
        direction LR
        L1[Action / Step]:::action
        L2{Decision Gate}:::decision
        L3([HPA Check]):::hpa
        L4[/Rollback\]:::rollback
        L5([Pipeline Complete]):::terminal
        L1 -->|Forward flow| L3
        L3 -->|Rollback path| L4
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% DEV LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph DEV["  DEV  ·  app-dev  ·  Replicas: 1–5"]
        direction TB
        A1[Source Commit\n& PR Merge]:::action
        A2[CI Build\n& Unit Tests]:::action
        A3[Docker Image\nBuild & Push]:::action
        A4[Deploy to Dev\nNamespace]:::action
        A5{Smoke Tests\nDev}:::check
        A6([HPA Check\nCPU >60% · MEM >70%]):::hpa
        A7{Dev Health Gate\nerror rate < 5%}:::decision
        RB_DEV[/Rollback\nDev Deployment\]:::rollback

        A1 --> A2
        A2 -->|tests pass| A3
        A3 --> A4
        A4 --> A5
        A5 -->|pass| A6
        A6 -->|within range| A7
        A7 -->|error rate ≥ 5%| RB_DEV
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% STAGING LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph STAGING["  STAGING  ·  app-staging  ·  Replicas: 2–10"]
        direction TB
        B1[Deploy to Staging\nNamespace]:::action
        B2{Integration &\nE2E Tests}:::check
        B3([HPA Check\nCPU >55% · MEM >65%]):::hpa
        B4{Performance /\nLoad Tests}:::check
        B5{Staging Health Gate\nerror rate < 2%}:::decision
        RB_STG[/Rollback\nStaging Deployment\]:::rollback

        B1 --> B2
        B2 -->|pass| B3
        B3 -->|within range| B4
        B4 -->|pass| B5
        B2 -->|tests fail| RB_STG
        B5 -->|error rate ≥ 2%| RB_STG
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% CANARY LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph CANARY["  CANARY  ·  app-canary  ·  Replicas: 2–15  ·  Weighted Traffic"]
        direction TB
        C1[Deploy Canary\n10% Traffic]:::action
        C2{Observe Metrics\n5 min}:::check
        C3([HPA Check\nCPU >50% · MEM >60%]):::hpa
        C4[Ramp to\n25% Traffic]:::action
        C5{Observe Metrics\n10 min}:::check
        C6[Ramp to\n50% Traffic]:::action
        C7{Canary Health Gate\nerror < 1% & p99 < 250ms}:::decision
        RB_CAN[/Rollback Canary\nShift Traffic → Stable\]:::rollback

        C1 --> C2
        C2 -->|metrics OK| C3
        C3 -->|within range| C4
        C4 --> C5
        C5 -->|metrics OK| C6
        C6 --> C7
        C2 -->|metrics degraded| RB_CAN
        C5 -->|metrics degraded| RB_CAN
        C7 -->|error ≥ 1% or p99 ≥ 250ms| RB_CAN
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% PRODUCTION LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph PRODUCTION["  PRODUCTION  ·  app-production  ·  Replicas: 5–50  ·  Blue-Green  ·  Approval Required"]
        direction TB
        subgraph BG_SETUP["Blue-Green: Prepare & Deploy Green Slot"]
            P1[Prepare Standby\nGreen Slot]:::bluegreen
            P2[Deploy to\nGreen Slot]:::bluegreen
            P3{Green Slot\nHealth Check}:::check
        end
        P4([HPA Check\nCPU >45% · MEM >55%]):::hpa
        P5{Blue-Green Switch\nDecision Gate\nerror < 0.5% & p99 < 200ms}:::decision
        subgraph BG_SWITCH["Blue-Green: Traffic Switch"]
            P6[Switch 100%\nTraffic → Green]:::bluegreen
            P7{Post-Switch\nVerification 3 min}:::check
        end
        P8[Decommission\nBlue Slot]:::action
        P9([Pipeline Complete ✓]):::terminal
        RB_PRD[/Rollback Prod\nRevert Traffic → Blue\]:::rollback

        P1 --> P2
        P2 --> P3
        P3 -->|healthy| P4
        P4 -->|within range| P5
        P5 -->|error < 0.5% & p99 < 200ms| P6
        P6 --> P7
        P7 -->|verified OK| P8
        P8 --> P9
        P3 -->|unhealthy| RB_PRD
        P5 -->|error ≥ 0.5% or p99 ≥ 200ms| RB_PRD
        P7 -->|verification failed| RB_PRD
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% GLOBAL HPA ACTIONS
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph GLOBAL["  GLOBAL ACTIONS"]
        direction LR
        HPA_UP[HPA: Scale Up\nReplicas]:::hpaaction
        HPA_DN[HPA: Scale Down\nReplicas]:::hpaaction
        ALERT[Alert On-Call\n& Open Incident]:::alertnode
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% CROSS-LANE FORWARD EDGES
    %% ============================================================
    A7 -->|error rate < 5%| B1
    B5 -->|error rate < 2%| C1
    C7 -->|error < 1% & p99 < 250ms| P1

    %% ============================================================
    %% HPA BRANCHES FROM EACH ENV
    %% ============================================================
    A6 -->|CPU >60% or MEM >70%| HPA_UP
    A6 -->|CPU <25% and MEM <30%| HPA_DN
    HPA_UP -->|scaled| A7
    HPA_DN -->|scaled| A7

    B3 -->|CPU >55% or MEM >65%| HPA_UP
    B3 -->|CPU <20% and MEM <25%| HPA_DN

    C3 -->|CPU >50% or MEM >60%| HPA_UP
    C3 -->|CPU <20% and MEM <25%| HPA_DN

    P4 -->|CPU >45% or MEM >55%| HPA_UP
    P4 -->|CPU <15% and MEM <20%| HPA_DN

    %% ============================================================
    %% ROLLBACK → ALERT
    %% ============================================================
    RB_DEV --> ALERT
    RB_STG --> ALERT
    RB_CAN --> ALERT
    RB_PRD --> ALERT

    %% ============================================================
    %% STYLES
    %% ============================================================
    classDef action fill:#1e5799,stroke:#4a9edd,color:#e8f4ff,rx:6
    classDef check fill:#1a4a1a,stroke:#4caf50,color:#c8f5c8,rx:6
    classDef decision fill:#5a3a00,stroke:#f5a623,color:#ffe4a0
    classDef hpa fill:#3a1a5a,stroke:#9b59b6,color:#e8d5ff,rx:20
    classDef hpaaction fill:#2d0a5a,stroke:#7c3aed,color:#ddd6fe,rx:6
    classDef rollback fill:#5a1a1a,stroke:#e53e3e,color:#ffd0d0
    classDef bluegreen fill:#0d4a5a,stroke:#00bcd4,color:#b2ebf2
    classDef terminal fill:#1a4a1a,stroke:#4caf50,color:#c8f5c8,rx:20
    classDef alertnode fill:#5a1a00,stroke:#ff6b35,color:#ffe0cc

    style DEV fill:#0d1f3c,stroke:#2d5986,color:#7ab3e0
    style STAGING fill:#0d2a1a,stroke:#2d6b3a,color:#7acc8a
    style CANARY fill:#2a1a0d,stroke:#6b4a2d,color:#ccaa7a
    style PRODUCTION fill:#1a0d2a,stroke:#5a3a7a,color:#b07acc
    style GLOBAL fill:#0a1628,stroke:#334455,color:#aabbcc
    style LEGEND fill:#0a1628,stroke:#334455,color:#aabbcc
    style BG_SETUP fill:#0a2530,stroke:#00bcd4,color:#80deea
    style BG_SWITCH fill:#0a2530,stroke:#00bcd4,color:#80deea

    %% ============================================================
    subgraph LEGEND["  LEGEND"]
        direction LR
        L1[Action / Step]:::action
        L2{Decision Gate}:::decision
        L3([HPA Check]):::hpa
        L4[/Rollback\]:::rollback
        L5([Pipeline Complete]):::terminal
        L1 -->|Forward flow| L3
        L3 -->|Rollback path| L4
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% DEV LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph DEV["  DEV  ·  app-dev  ·  Replicas: 1–5"]
        direction TB
        A1[Source Commit\n& PR Merge]:::action
        A2[CI Build\n& Unit Tests]:::action
        A3[Docker Image\nBuild & Push]:::action
        A4[Deploy to Dev\nNamespace]:::action
        A5{Smoke Tests\nDev}:::check
        A6([HPA Check\nCPU >60% · MEM >70%]):::hpa
        A7{Dev Health Gate\nerror rate < 5%}:::decision
        RB_DEV[/Rollback\nDev Deployment\]:::rollback

        A1 --> A2
        A2 -->|tests pass| A3
        A3 --> A4
        A4 --> A5
        A5 -->|pass| A6
        A6 -->|within range| A7
        A7 -->|error rate ≥ 5%| RB_DEV
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% STAGING LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph STAGING["  STAGING  ·  app-staging  ·  Replicas: 2–10"]
        direction TB
        B1[Deploy to Staging\nNamespace]:::action
        B2{Integration &\nE2E Tests}:::check
        B3([HPA Check\nCPU >55% · MEM >65%]):::hpa
        B4{Performance /\nLoad Tests}:::check
        B5{Staging Health Gate\nerror rate < 2%}:::decision
        RB_STG[/Rollback\nStaging Deployment\]:::rollback

        B1 --> B2
        B2 -->|pass| B3
        B3 -->|within range| B4
        B4 -->|pass| B5
        B2 -->|tests fail| RB_STG
        B5 -->|error rate ≥ 2%| RB_STG
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% CANARY LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph CANARY["  CANARY  ·  app-canary  ·  Replicas: 2–15  ·  Weighted Traffic"]
        direction TB
        C1[Deploy Canary\n10% Traffic]:::action
        C2{Observe Metrics\n5 min}:::check
        C3([HPA Check\nCPU >50% · MEM >60%]):::hpa
        C4[Ramp to\n25% Traffic]:::action
        C5{Observe Metrics\n10 min}:::check
        C6[Ramp to\n50% Traffic]:::action
        C7{Canary Health Gate\nerror < 1% & p99 < 250ms}:::decision
        RB_CAN[/Rollback Canary\nShift Traffic → Stable\]:::rollback

        C1 --> C2
        C2 -->|metrics OK| C3
        C3 -->|within range| C4
        C4 --> C5
        C5 -->|metrics OK| C6
        C6 --> C7
        C2 -->|metrics degraded| RB_CAN
        C5 -->|metrics degraded| RB_CAN
        C7 -->|error ≥ 1% or p99 ≥ 250ms| RB_CAN
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% PRODUCTION LANE
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph PRODUCTION["  PRODUCTION  ·  app-production  ·  Replicas: 5–50  ·  Blue-Green  ·  Approval Required"]
        direction TB
        subgraph BG_SETUP["Blue-Green: Prepare & Deploy Green Slot"]
            P1[Prepare Standby\nGreen Slot]:::bluegreen
            P2[Deploy to\nGreen Slot]:::bluegreen
            P3{Green Slot\nHealth Check}:::check
        end
        P4([HPA Check\nCPU >45% · MEM >55%]):::hpa
        P5{Blue-Green Switch\nDecision Gate\nerror < 0.5% & p99 < 200ms}:::decision
        subgraph BG_SWITCH["Blue-Green: Traffic Switch"]
            P6[Switch 100%\nTraffic → Green]:::bluegreen
            P7{Post-Switch\nVerification 3 min}:::check
        end
        P8[Decommission\nBlue Slot]:::action
        P9([Pipeline Complete ✓]):::terminal
        RB_PRD[/Rollback Prod\nRevert Traffic → Blue\]:::rollback

        P1 --> P2
        P2 --> P3
        P3 -->|healthy| P4
        P4 -->|within range| P5
        P5 -->|error < 0.5% & p99 < 200ms| P6
        P6 --> P7
        P7 -->|verified OK| P8
        P8 --> P9
        P3 -->|unhealthy| RB_PRD
        P5 -->|error ≥ 0.5% or p99 ≥ 200ms| RB_PRD
        P7 -->|verification failed| RB_PRD
    end

    %% ============================================================
    %% GLOBAL HPA ACTIONS
    %% ============================================================
    subgraph GLOBAL["  GLOBAL ACTIONS"]
        direction LR
        HPA_UP[HPA: Scale Up\nReplicas]:::hpaaction
        HPA_DN[HPA: Scale Down\nReplicas]:::hpaaction
        ALERT[Alert On-Call\n& Open Incident]:::alertnode
    end

# ── Helper: draw rounded box ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7.5, text2=None, bold=False):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.15, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#aaccee', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    return (cx, cy, w, h)

def diamond(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    # draw diamond using polygon
    dx, dy = w/2, h/2
    pts = np.array([[cx, cy+dy], [cx+dx, cy], [cx, cy-dy], [cx-dx, cy]])
    poly = plt.Polygon(pts, closed=True, facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                       linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.12, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#ffe4a0', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def pill(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={h/2}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#e8d5ff', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, style='->', dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx, my = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

def curved_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, rad=0.3, dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx = (x1+x2)/2
        my = (y1+y2)/2 + abs(rad) * abs(x2-x1) * 0.25
        ax.text(mx, my, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

# ── Helper: draw rounded box ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7.5, text2=None, bold=False):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.15, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#aaccee', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    return (cx, cy, w, h)

def diamond(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    # draw diamond using polygon
    dx, dy = w/2, h/2
    pts = np.array([[cx, cy+dy], [cx+dx, cy], [cx, cy-dy], [cx-dx, cy]])
    poly = plt.Polygon(pts, closed=True, facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                       linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.12, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#ffe4a0', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

    y0 = cy - h/2

                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={h/2}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)

                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#e8d5ff', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:

                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, style='->', dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx, my = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

def curved_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, rad=0.3, dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx = (x1+x2)/2
        my = (y1+y2)/2 + abs(rad) * abs(x2-x1) * 0.25
        ax.text(mx, my, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

# ── Draw lane backgrounds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_DEFS = [
    ('dev',     'DEV',     'app-dev · HPA 1–5 replicas · err gate < 5%',    C['dev'],  C['dev_border'],  C['dev_text'],  16.1, 18.9),

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""K8s Multi-Environment Deployment Pipeline – swimlane diagram."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
from matplotlib.patheffects import withStroke
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FIG_W, FIG_H = 28, 20
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H))
ax.set_xlim(0, FIG_W)
ax.set_ylim(0, FIG_H)
ax.axis('off')
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#050d1a')
ax.set_facecolor('#050d1a')

# ── Color palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C = {
    'dev':        '#0a2040',
    'dev_border': '#2a6aae',
    'dev_text':   '#7ab3e0',
    'stg':        '#0a2010',
    'stg_border': '#2a7a3a',
    'stg_text':   '#7acc8a',
    'can':        '#201005',
    'can_border': '#8a5a10',
    'can_text':   '#ccaa7a',
    'prd':        '#140520',
    'prd_border': '#6a3aae',
    'prd_text':   '#c09ae0',
    'action':     '#1a4a7a',
    'action_b':   '#4a9edd',
    'check':      '#1a4a2a',
    'check_b':    '#4caf50',
    'gate':       '#4a3000',
    'gate_b':     '#f5a623',
    'hpa':        '#3a1060',
    'hpa_b':      '#9b59b6',
    'rollback':   '#5a0a0a',
    'rollback_b': '#e53e3e',
    'bluegreen':  '#023a4a',
    'bluegreen_b':'#00bcd4',
    'terminal':   '#0d3a1a',
    'terminal_b': '#00e676',
    'alert':      '#4a1800',
    'alert_b':    '#ff6b35',
    'fw_arrow':   '#4a90d9',
    'rb_arrow':   '#e53e3e',
    'hpa_arrow':  '#9b59b6',
    'bg_arrow':   '#00bcd4',
    'text_light': '#e8f4ff',
    'text_dim':   '#aabbcc',
    'lane_sep':   '#1a2a40',
}

# ── Layout constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_X = 0.5           # left edge of lane header column
LANE_W = 3.2           # lane header width
NODE_H = 0.55          # node box height
NODE_W_STD = 2.6       # standard node width
NODE_W_GATE = 2.4      # gate diamond approx
NODE_W_HPA = 2.8       # HPA pill
LANE_LABEL_X = 1.6     # center of lane header

    'header': 1.6,
    'col1':   4.8,   # main action column per lane
    'col2':   7.8,
    'col3':   10.8,
    'col4':   13.6,
    'col5':   16.4,
    'col6':   19.0,
    'col7':   21.6,
    'col8':   24.0,
    'rollback': 26.0,
    'global_hpa': 26.5,
}

# Y center of each swimlane

    'dev':    17.5,
    'staging': 13.5,
    'canary':  9.0,
    'prod':    4.0,
}
LANE_H = {
    'dev':    2.8,
    'staging':3.5,
    'canary': 4.5,
    'prod':   5.5,
}

# ── Helper: draw rounded box ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7.5, text2=None, bold=False):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.15, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#aaccee', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    return (cx, cy, w, h)

def diamond(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    # draw diamond using polygon
    dx, dy = w/2, h/2
    pts = np.array([[cx, cy+dy], [cx+dx, cy], [cx, cy-dy], [cx-dx, cy]])
    poly = plt.Polygon(pts, closed=True, facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                       linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.12, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#ffe4a0', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def pill(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={h/2}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#e8d5ff', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, style='->', dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx, my = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

def curved_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, rad=0.3, dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx = (x1+x2)/2
        my = (y1+y2)/2 + abs(rad) * abs(x2-x1) * 0.25
        ax.text(mx, my, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

# ── Draw lane backgrounds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LANE_DEFS = [
    ('dev',     'DEV',     'app-dev · HPA 1–5 replicas · err gate < 5%',    C['dev'],  C['dev_border'],  C['dev_text'],  16.1, 18.9),
    ('staging', 'STAGING', 'app-staging · HPA 2–10 replicas · err gate < 2%',C['stg'], C['stg_border'],  C['stg_text'],  11.8, 15.2),
    ('canary',  'CANARY',  'app-canary · HPA 2–15 replicas · Weighted 10→25→50% · err < 1% p99 < 250ms', C['can'], C['can_border'], C['can_text'], 6.8, 11.2),
    ('prod',    'PRODUCTION','app-production · HPA 5–50 replicas · Blue-Green · Approval Required · err < 0.5% p99 < 200ms', C['prd'], C['prd_border'], C['prd_text'],  1.5,  6.2),
]

# ── Helper: draw rounded box ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def rbox(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7.5, text2=None, bold=False):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.06",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    fw = 'bold' if bold else 'normal'
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.15, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#aaccee', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontweight=fw,
                fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    return (cx, cy, w, h)

def diamond(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    # draw diamond using polygon
    dx, dy = w/2, h/2
    pts = np.array([[cx, cy+dy], [cx+dx, cy], [cx, cy-dy], [cx-dx, cy]])
    poly = plt.Polygon(pts, closed=True, facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                       linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(poly)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.12, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#ffe4a0', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def pill(ax, cx, cy, w, h, fill, border, text, fontsize=7, text2=None):
    x0 = cx - w/2
    y0 = cy - h/2
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x0, y0), w, h,
                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={h/2}",
                         facecolor=fill, edgecolor=border,
                         linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    if text2:
        ax.text(cx, cy + 0.10, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
        ax.text(cx, cy - 0.14, text2, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize - 0.5, color='#e8d5ff', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(cx, cy, text, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=fontsize, color=C['text_light'], fontfamily='monospace', zorder=4)

def arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, style='->', dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx, my = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        ax.text(mx, my + 0.08, label, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

def curved_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label='', lw=1.4, rad=0.3, dashed=False):
    ls = '--' if dashed else '-'
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                                linestyle=ls),
                zorder=5)
    if label:
        mx = (x1+x2)/2
        my = (y1+y2)/2 + abs(rad) * abs(x2-x1) * 0.25
        ax.text(mx, my, label, ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=5.5, color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=6,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.1', fc='#0a1628', ec='none', alpha=0.85))

steps.message:
The diagram looks excellent. All five goal requirements are met:

1. **End-to-end pipeline flow** — clear left-to-right progression through all 4 environments
2. **Rollback paths** — red dashed arrows from every gate/check to rollback nodes, all funneling to Alert On-Call
3. **Blue-green switch** — dashed cyan border zones highlight "Blue-Green Deployment Zone" and "Traffic Switch (Green Active)" with the decision gate visible
4. **HPA scaling checkpoints** — purple pill nodes at each environment with CPU/MEM thresholds annotated
5. **Swimlane separation** — four color-coded horizontal bands (blue=Dev, green=Staging, amber=Canary, purple=Production)

The output is saved at `/app/output/result.png`.
